api:
<UpSet data={items} sets={|i: &Item| i.sets} />
PropTypeDefault
data, sets, value, separatoras on <Venn>
max_intersectionsusize: combination bars shown, largest first20
min_sizef64: hide smaller combinations0.

Bars at the top are exact combinations, the dot matrix below shows which sets each one contains, and the bars on the left are set sizes. Use it when there are too many sets for a Venn diagram.

examples.title: Movie genres
examples.description: Bars are exact combinations, the matrix shows which sets, and the left bars are set sizes.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn movies() {
    let data = use_signal(genres());
    rsx! { <UpSet data={data} sets={|m: &Member| m.sets} value={|m: &Member| m.count} class="h-96" /> }
}

examples.title: From items
examples.description: Each row is one item; combinations are counted.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn from_items() {
    let data = use_signal(
        (0..300u64)
            .map(|index| Member {
                sets: [
                    "Web",
                    "Web&Mobile",
                    "Mobile",
                    "Web&Desktop",
                    "Desktop",
                    "Web&Mobile&Desktop",
                    "Mobile&Desktop",
                ][((noise(index) * noise(index + 7)) * 7.) as usize % 7],
                count: 1.,
            })
            .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
    );
    rsx! { <UpSet data={data} sets={|m: &Member| m.sets} class="h-80" /> }
}

examples.title: Eight sets
examples.description: UpSet scales where Venn diagrams cannot.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn many_sets() {
    let labels = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F", "G", "H"];
    let combos: Vec<&'static str> = vec![
        "A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F", "G", "H", "A&B", "C&D", "E&F", "G&H", "A&C&E", "B&D&F",
        "A&H",
    ];
    let data = use_signal(
        combos
            .iter()
            .enumerate()
            .map(|(index, sets)| Member {
                sets,
                count: (5. + noise(index as u64) * 60.).round(),
            })
            .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
    );
    let _ = labels;
    rsx! { <UpSet data={data} sets={|m: &Member| m.sets} value={|m: &Member| m.count} class="h-96" /> }
}
